description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Log controller in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for handling the display, download, and clearing of log files.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing system log files in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of log files, their sizes, and provides options to download or clear logs.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the download of a specific log file, validating its existence and size before sending it to the client.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a specified log file if the user has permission.
